sentences.text: Jamninkaornis is classified as a passerine bird belonging to the suborder Tyranni.
The genus contains only one known species, Jamninkaornis kencampbelli, known from a single right coracoid and humerus preserved on two separate rock slabs.
This species was described as a new genus and species in 2026 by Zbigniew M. Bochenski and colleagues. The genus name combines the name of a local stream and valley with the Greek word for bird.
Jamninkaornis lived during the Oligocene epoch, specifically the Late Oligocene (Chattian), approximately 26 million years ago in Poland.
